section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: 6 ## Volume of Accidental Deaths per Lakh of Population A study of the figures would show that accidental deaths in India did not reveal any definite trend from 1969 to 1976. There was an upward trend to begin with when from 130755 in 1969, the number of accidental deaths increased to 139752 in 1970. After some fall in 1971, there has been a steady increase from 106184 in 1972 to 113016 in 1975. Once again in 1976, the total accidental deaths registered decline from 113016 in 1975 to 111611 in 1976. The figure of 1976 is lower than the figure of 1969 by as much as —14.6%.
